description: Implements the Keylet::check method to validate STLedgerEntry objects against Keylet type and key constraints within the xrpl namespace.

false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for sle.getType()
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: XRPL_ASSERT macro validates sle.getType() for empty strings

false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for type
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: if (type == ltANY) validates type for empty strings

false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for type and sle.getType()
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: if (type == ltCHILD) validates type and sle.getType() for empty strings

false_positive_patterns.evidence: return sle.getType() == type && sle.key() == key at Keylet::check
false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for sle.getType() and sle.key()
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: return sle.getType() == type && sle.key() == key validates sle.getType() and sle.key() for empty strings

validations.error_thrown: Assertion failure (likely aborts or throws, depending on XRPL_ASSERT implementation)
validates: Ensures that the STLedgerEntry type is not ltANY
Ensures that the STLedgerEntry type is not ltCHILD
If Keylet type is ltANY, always passes validation
If Keylet type is ltCHILD, passes if sle.getType() is not ltDIR_NODE
Checks that sle.getType() matches Keylet type
Checks that sle.key() matches Keylet key
